fields.description: Fieldname on the reference doctype holding the Project link. Dropdown lists that doctype's Link fields pointing to Project. Everyone assigned in that project's Committee (with an applicable Role Master binding) is automatically included as a recipient - no manual role selection needed.
fields.label: Project Field

fields.description: Fieldname on the reference doctype holding the Department link. Dropdown lists that doctype's Link fields pointing to Department. That department's Department Head is automatically included as a recipient - no role selection needed.
fields.label: Department Field

fields.description: When ON, finds whichever Role is required to act on the document's CURRENT workflow state, then resolves it via a priority chain: (1) Project Committee, if a committee position is bound to that Role; (2) Department Head, only if they personally hold that Role; (3) any user in the system directly assigned that Role (Has Role) - this last step is what covers company-wide roles like CEO / MD / Purchase Head that were never going to be in a Project Committee table. Each step only runs if the previous one found nobody valid. This is looked up dynamically every time from the reference doctype's active Workflow, so one rule automatically routes to the right approver for every status without a separate rule or condition per state. When OFF, the entire applicable committee AND the Department Head are both notified together (general 'keep everyone informed' mode, no fallback chain).
fields.label: Notify Only Current State's Approver

fields.description: Pick an existing document of the Reference Document Type to test this resolution against, using "Preview Resolved Users" below. Not used at send time - only for testing this configuration.
fields.label: Sample Reference Document (for preview)

fields.description: The final, resolved list of users. Untick "Enabled" on any row to silence that specific person without removing them.

fields.description: Individual Emails: one email per recipient (safest for privacy, uses one send credit per person). Single Email (To): one send, everyone visible to each other in To. Single Email (BCC): one send, recipients hidden from each other.
